quiz.title: Batch and Stream Processing
quiz.description: Comparing batch and stream processing paradigms, latency and throughput trade-offs, and when to use each approach.

questions.option_a: Processing a large collection of data all at once, typically on a schedule
questions.option_b: Processing a single record the instant it arrives
questions.correct_answer: Processing a large collection of data all at once, typically on a schedule

questions.option_a: Continuously processing data as individual events arrive, with low latency
questions.option_b: Processing data only once per year
questions.option_c: A way to permanently delete data
questions.option_d: A method for encrypting files at rest
questions.correct_answer: Continuously processing data as individual events arrive, with low latency

questions.question_text: Which processing style is generally better suited for generating a fraud-alert within seconds of a suspicious transaction?
Which processing style is typically well suited for computing a company's end-of-day financial reconciliation?
What is 'latency' in the context of data processing?
questions.option_a: The time delay between an event occurring and it being processed or available
questions.option_b: The total storage capacity of a database
questions.option_c: The number of columns in a table
questions.option_d: The color scheme of a dashboard
questions.correct_answer: The time delay between an event occurring and it being processed or available

questions.question_text: What is 'throughput' in the context of data processing systems?
questions.option_a: The amount of data or number of events processed in a given time period
questions.option_b: The number of users logged in
questions.option_c: The physical size of a server room
questions.correct_answer: The amount of data or number of events processed in a given time period

questions.option_a: A batch layer for comprehensive historical processing and a speed layer for real-time processing
questions.option_b: Two batch layers and no streaming
questions.option_c: Only a single real-time layer with no batch processing
questions.option_d: AWS Lambda functions exclusively, unrelated to architecture patterns
questions.correct_answer: A batch layer for comprehensive historical processing and a speed layer for real-time processing

questions.question_text: What is a key challenge specific to stream processing that batch processing doesn't usually face?
questions.option_a: Handling continuously arriving, potentially out-of-order data while maintaining state
questions.option_b: Reading data from a file on disk
questions.option_c: Running a job once a day
questions.correct_answer: Handling continuously arriving, potentially out-of-order data while maintaining state

questions.question_text: What does 'windowing' mean in stream processing?
questions.option_a: Grouping events into finite time-based or count-based chunks for aggregation
questions.correct_answer: Grouping events into finite time-based or count-based chunks for aggregation

questions.question_text: Which of these tools is commonly associated with stream processing?
questions.option_a: Apache Kafka Streams or Spark Structured Streaming
questions.correct_answer: Apache Kafka Streams or Spark Structured Streaming
